A body of mass $20kg$ falls vertically downward. Let $v$ be its velocity, with downward taken as the positive direction.
The air resistance on the body is proportional to its velocity with a constant of proportionality $k = 5kg/s$ and acts opposite to the direction of motion.

What is the terminal velocity $v_{term}$ of the body? Assume the acceleration due to gravity is $g = 9.8m/s^{2}$, and the only forces acting on the body are the weight due to gravity and drag.

$v_{term} =$
{{field-1}}
$m/s$

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
